aboutText: The Ritchie Group (TRG) is a second-generation family office, based in Salt Lake City, Utah, that has owned and developed real estate for over 40 years. TRG's primary focus is on multifamily, self-storage, industrial, and hospitality real estate development projects. TRG has a development queue of 3400+ multifamily units, 400+ keys of hospitality, and 4.4M SF of industrial warehouse at various stages of design and development.
